description: Directive inondation - Activité économique du territoire à risque important d'inondations (TRI) de La Rochelle is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DREAL Poitou-Charentes. Geographic dataset produced by the GIS Directive Flooding of the territory at significant flood risk (TRI) of the Charentais coastline and mapped for reporting purposes for the European Floods Directive. European Directive 2007/60/EC of 23 October 2007 on the assessment and management of flood risks (OJ L 288, 06-11-2007, p. Coverage: DREAL Poitou-Charentes. The portal shows the English title as "Flood Directive - Economic activity of the territory at significant flood risk (TRI) of La Rochelle" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is DREAL Poitou-Charentes. Its keywords include poitou-charentes, risque, niveau-de-diffusion, dreal-pc, grand-public, donnees-ouvertes. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV, SHP, JSON. The listing shows 2015-07-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
